marks.gloss_en: one who specifies silver for a 'my weight' vow gives silver, and one who specifies gold gives gold
the sugya's synthesis: the unrestricted 'anything at all' is read through Rechava's locale condition, so the vow is discharged with any material locally sold by weight
where onions are sold by weight, an unspecified 'my weight' vow may be discharged with onions
